root_cause.text: Ceph incorrectly assumed that a negative dentry is always unhashed, causing d_add() to rehash an already-hashed dentry and corrupt the dcache hash bucket.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explicitly states that "Ceph can call d_add(dentry, NULL) on a negative dentry that is already present in the primary dcache hash" and that this "can corrupt the bucket, including creating a self-loop." The patch fixes two code paths in fs/ceph/dir.c by adding a d_unhashed() check before calling d_add() for negative dentries.
